hard_failures: Problem 1 requires the center coordinates, radius, and boundary-point check, but verification omits the center; problems 2 and 3 require full circle equations while the checks record only radius-squared values.
These omitted centers and equations are machine-checkable printed answers, not optional work.

errors.description: Several required circle centers and standard-form equations are absent from verification.

artifact_findings: Independent results include center (4,-3), radius 7; (x+2)^2+(y-5)^2=36; center (3,-2), radius 5 and equation (x-3)^2+(y+2)^2=25; ripple radius 4.47; (x-3)^2+(y+4)^2=36; x=-2 or 6; (x+5)^2+(y-2)^2=9; and no real graph for r^2=-7.

rationale: The circle mathematics and completing-square work are accurate, but the verifier omits several full equations and a required center. Those are decisive objective coverage failures.
